Subject: Proposed demo — Dec 1 (on-site) + vendor intake checklist

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the interest — excited to show the Redwood inference stack to the MedCore team. We tentatively penciled in an on-site demo for Tue, Dec 1 at 10:00 AM PT and a follow-up Q&A with your engineering and security stakeholders later that afternoon.

Before we lock rooms and attendees, quick ask from procurement/security side: can you confirm whether your vendor intake team requires the signed supplier form, an SSO IdP test account, and a completed security questionnaire prior to any live demo? I attached the draft supplier form we typically see (MedCore_Supplier_Form_Template.pdf).

If those items are required, we can either do a lightweight remote demo on the same date (no sensitive data shared) or shift the on-site walkthrough by ~1–2 weeks to give MedCore time to circulate the questionnaire. Either option works for us — want to minimize churn for your team.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2-Summary.pdf (overview), MedCore_Supplier_Form_Template.pdf

Next steps / ask: please confirm the intake prerequisites and whether procurement will require a signed DPA/technical questionnaire before the demo. If so, happy to route Karthik on our side to handle intake.

Best,
Marcus Lin

Hi Marcus —

Thanks for the note and the materials. Quick heads up from procurement: MedCore requires a completed vendor security questionnaire and either a signed DPA or vendor-specific terms before onsite vendor visits that include privileged product walkthroughs. We also ask for IdP integration details ahead of any SSO-enabled demo so our SREs can provision a test role.

I looped in Adam from our security intake team and procurement; Adam / procurement team will share the questionnaire and next steps. Realistically this intake will take 3–7 business days depending on calendar availability — so Dec 1 is probably too soon for a full on-site demo.

Would you be open to a short remote preview on Dec 1 (30–45 mins) focused on architecture and capability highlights, with the full on-site POC once the intake items are completed? If Redwood prefers to wait for the full on-site experience, we can aim for the week of Dec 14.

Marcus / Sarah —

Thanks — Karthik here. I pulled the SOC2 summary and the typical vendor questionnaire we see from hospitals. To make the procurement loop as smooth as possible, here's a short checklist of what will usually unblock a full on-site demo: 

- Completed vendor questionnaire (PDF form with 40–60 questions)
- Signed DPA or confirmation DPA is in procurement queue
- IdP test account details (SAML metadata or an SP-initiated test user) for a dev/test role
- Contact for MedCore security engineer to run a quick IdP smoke test (15–30 mins)
- Any requested network or data-flow diagrams (we have a redacted network diagram ready)

If MedCore can share the questionnaire and a point-of-contact for IdP by Mon Nov 30, we should be able to get the intake closed and confirm an on-site slot for the week of Dec 14. Otherwise, propose a tentative on-site week of Dec 21 as a fallback.

I'll upload the redacted network/data-flow doc to the shared drive and send a secure link once you confirm the contact.

Karthik Iyer
Security & Product Integrations, Redwood Inference
